verses.text: <pb/><e>Abù Ọma nke diri Onye-isi Abù; n'elu Shushan Eduth: Michtam Devid, izí ihe: mb͕e ọ lusoro Eram-naharaim, luso kwa Eram-zoba, ọ̀gù, Joab we laghachi, tib͕ue Edom nime Ndagwurugwu Nnú, orú nnù madu na nnù iri.</e> <pb/><t>Chineke, I juwo ayi aju, I tiwawo ayi,</t> <t>I wewo iwe; I gēme ka ayi laghachi ọzọ.</t>
<t>I mewo ka ala ma jijiji; I b͕awawo ya:</t> <t>Mezie ntiwa-ya nile; n'ihi na o mewo nkpatu.</t>
<t>I mewo ka ndi-Gi hu ihe siri ike:</t> <t>I mewo ka ayi ṅua manya nke isu-ngọngọ.</t>
I nyewo ndi nātu egwu Gi ọkọlọtọ, Ka ewe welie ya elu dika ọkọlọtọ n'ihi ezi-okwu. Selah
<t>Ka ewe dọputa ndi I huru n'anya,</t> <t>Were aka-nri-Gi zọputa, za kwa ayi.</t>
<t>Chineke ekwuwo okwu n'di-nsọ-Ya; ka m'ṅuria ọṅu-agha:</t> <t>M'gēkè Shekem, tù kwa ndagwurugwu Sukot.</t>
<t>Mu nwe Gilead, ọ bu kwa mu nwe Manase;</t> <t>Efraim bu kwa ebe siri ike nke isim;</t> <t>Juda bu nkpa-n'aka-ezem.</t>
<t>Moab bu ite ọsisa-arum;</t> <t>N'elu Edom ka m'gātu akpukpọ-ukwum:</t> <t>Filistia, tie nkpu n'ihim.</t>
<t>Ònye gēdubàm nke-ọma n'obodo ewusiri ike?</t> <t>Ònye duruworom rue Edom?</t>
<t>Ọ̀ bughi Gi onwe-gi, Chineke, juworo ayi aju?</t> <t>I dighi-apu kwa ije agha n'etiti usu nile nke ndi-agha ayi, Chineke.</t>
<t>Yere ayi aka ka ayi pua n'aka onye-nkpab͕u:</t> <t>N'ihi na ihe-efu ka nzọputa madu bu.</t>
<t>Nime Chineke ayi ga-eme ihe dìnkpà:</t> <t>Ọ bu kwa Ya onwe-ya gāzọda ndi nākpab͕u ayi</t>
